holdings.thesis: HOLD: thesis intact and strengthening -- DA Davidson raised its PT to $175 (kept Buy) on top of Evercore's 9/1 upgrade to Outperform/$210, both citing strong product/monetization momentum (DAUs +23% YoY to 58.7M, paid subscribers +17%). The earnings-growth-decline flag remains attributable to AI-feature reinvestment, not demand weakness. Position is at 14.9% of portfolio, just under the 15% max_position_pct cap -- watching for a forced trim if price appreciates further, not trimming today since it hasn't breached the cap.

HOLD: thesis intact. Stock went ex-dividend ($0.22) today as scheduled; the known DOJ/FTC regulatory overhangs are unchanged, not new negative information.
